audit.note: K1 and K3 are evaluated on a model-based projection: the simulator run with the measured per-cell fold and state fraction. They are not plasma measurements, and a real plasma cohort could move them. K4 rests on measurements; K2 and K5 are not evaluable on the evidence in this repository.

conditions.condition: The state-specific readout carries no information beyond tumour burden
conditions.basis: model-based projection with measured inputs; not a plasma measurement

conditions.condition: The state cannot be inferred from plasma at any affordable read budget
conditions.scope: per dataset and channel, over the depth x panel-size grid
conditions.basis: model-based projection with measured inputs; not a plasma measurement

conditions.condition: The state is not present, or not relapse-associated, in lung
conditions.how_detected: D2: no state-associated methylation delta between primary and relapsed tissue
conditions.scope: the condition as written names a methylation delta

evidence.note: The state is present and more frequent after treatment in EGFR-mutant NSCLC, which is evidence against K2 firing. It is not the methylation delta the condition names, and no primary-versus-relapsed methylation comparison exists in this repository, so the condition is recorded as not evaluable rather than passed. For relapsed SCLC there is no treatment-naive comparator at all.

conditions.basis: partially addressable, not evaluable as written

conditions.condition: Every candidate target has an unacceptable therapeutic window
conditions.how_detected: D0 gate: GTEx specificity verdict fails

evidence.state_resolved_counter_evidence: The state-resolved audits found the state channel-high in the target tissue for the matched disease and channel, so a state-directed rather than systemic modality is not excluded by the expression evidence. No such modality exists in this programme, and the D0 window findings for KCa3.1 (lung expression 12x below minor salivary gland, loss-of-function intolerance, on-target neurological and cardiac liabilities) and for Piezo1 (no separation from PIEZO2, no clinical asset) are unaffected.

conditions.condition: Suppressing the state does not reduce relapse competence in patient-derived models
conditions.how_detected: D5: no differential killing of the state-bearing clone
conditions.scope: requires perturbation and a viability readout

evidence.note: No wet-lab arm has been run. The state-resolved datasets are observational, and one of them (GSE325242, the RORB-loss organoid study) would have been the closest available perturbation system, but its deposit carries no gene annotation and cannot be measured.
